ValidationRule.description: SS-13948 - Only Product Team can edit the PM assigned field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Road_Map_Request",
ISCHANGED(PM_Assigned__c),
NOT($Profile.Name = "Tanium System Administrator"), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules),
OR( ISBLANK($User.Department), NOT(CONTAINS($User.Department, "Product")), $User.Department = "Product Marketing" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to edit the PM Assign field. Only Product Team may update this field on Roadmap records.
